elements.text:
Interface testing ran in three passes for [CLIENT]. Pass
one validated field-level mapping with synthetic messages generated from
the contract sheets. Pass two replayed thirty days of production message
traffic into the test environment and reconciled outcomes against the
legacy system's results, with every mismatch dispositioned by a named
analyst. Pass three was a full-volume soak test at twice peak load,
running the error-queue procedures live. Exit required zero unexplained
mismatches and a signed disposition log approved by the program board.

The [CLIENT] program ran with a blended team: an onshore
engagement lead, two functional architects for finance and payroll, a
data-conversion lead, and an offshore build pod of six that rotated one
member onshore each quarter for knowledge continuity. Client-side
counterparts were named for every workstream, and no deliverable was
accepted without its counterpart's review. Staffing for the eleven-month
engagement fit within the [FEE] services budget.
